About Univrses
Univrses is a Stockholm-based 3D Computer Vision and AI company. We provide the perception and spatial awareness necessary for an increasingly autonomous world. While our roots are in the automotive sector, we have pioneered a new category: Infrastructure Intelligence. Our 3DAI™ system transforms ordinary vehicles into sophisticated mobile sensors, providing road authorities across Europe (Sweden, UK, Italy, and beyond) with real-time, actionable insights. We are shifting city management from reactive repairs to proactive, data-driven maintenance—saving costs, reducing CO2 emissions, and improving public safety.
The Role
In your new developer role, you will take part in building the 3DAI™ platform. It is a scalable answer to the growing demand for data about the urban environment and part of our efforts in smart city development. You will play an important role in designing, building and scaling the platform. 3DAI™ is still a young product and you will have a lot to contribute and freedom to shape the project.

You will be responsible for growing our platform for storing, processing and visualizing data.

You will use your experience to design efficient solutions for our backend and frontend systems.

You will have the opportunity to create innovative technologies that will change people's lives and transform the world into a better place

Who you are
You have at least 3+ years of experience in Fullstack software development using Node.js and Typescript on the backend, and React (Vite SPA) on the frontend.

You are experienced with AWS cloud platform development.

You have excellent general understanding of REST APIs and GraphQL.

You are comfortable taking high-level front-end designs and turning that into readable, maintainable, best-practice React code.

You can build web-services from high level specifications, including figuring out database schemas, security considerations, logging and monitoring, and how best to scale out deployments to handle lots of users and data.

You have an enthusiasm to tackle large-scale data challenges, with prior experience on high-performance analytic databases as a bonus.

You like working in a team and sharing your knowledge. You are open to giving advice and listening to feedback.

You are passionate about writing high-quality code and care for ensuring code validity by writing unit and integration tests.

You keep up-to-date with best practices and new technologies.

You have an aspiration to see your ideas move into production.

Bonus points
You have experience working with any of these systems or technologies:

Serverless computing (e.g. AWS Lambdas)

Familiar to infrastructure as code technologies such as Docker, AWS Cloudformation/CDK

Geo spatial tools and databases such as PostGIS

MUI (Material-UI) based front-end components

E2E testing frameworks like Playwright

What’s in it for You?
We provide the environment and the tools for you to do the best work of your career.

Responsibility: Become a true stakeholder in a small team where your work actually matters.

Professional Evolution: You will be working on exciting projects involving game-changing technology with an opportunity to improve the world through autonomy and intelligence

The "Work-Life" Blend: Enjoy flexible work hours and a culture that values output over "desk time".

Upsides: A secure Pension Plan and Wellness activities for up to 5 000 SEK per year paid by the company.

The Univrses Culture:

Monday Momentum: Kick off the week with team breakfast.

Thursday Knowledge: Weekly Lunch & Learns where internal or external speakers present interesting topics, while the company pays for and caters the lunch to keep your technical and commercial skills sharp.

Friday Wind-down: Celebrate the week’s wins with our Friday After Work sessions (free beer from our well-curated beer fridge!)

The Workspace: A bright, collaborative office in Stockholm equipped with the essentials (yes, including the mandatory startup ping-pong table).

Are You Our Next Full Stack Engineer?
If you are a driven, creative strategist ready to shape the future of autonomous systems, we want to hear from you.
To apply, please include the following:

Your CV

A link to your LinkedIn profile

A brief introduction (tell us about a time you turned a challenging customer situation into a success).

Note: All application materials must be in English.

The opportunity
What if your next role puts you at the center of multi-million-dollar projects transforming the energy system? As a Senior Tender Manager, you will shape and execute bid strategies for large, complex HVDC pursuits, coordinating multidisciplinary teams and shaping solutions that bring together capabilities from across the Hitachi Energy portfolio. From defining the bid strategy to presenting a compelling technical and commercial offering to the customer, you will play a central role in winning the projects that will shape the future power grid.
“At Bid & Proposals, we lead the tendering of large-scale HVDC greenfield projects worldwide. My team focuses on the Northern European (NEU) market and is based in Sweden and the UK. Last year alone, our department secured 5 HVDC projects across the NEU region, giving our team a direct role in shaping Hitachi Energy’s business pipeline. We play a key role in driving business growth, supporting net-zero targets, and helping secure Europe’s energy supply..” – Louise Hellman, Hiring Manager.
Your base will be in Ludvika or Västerås, Sweden, and you will be part of the HVDC product group within Hitachi Energy. HVDC technology has been on the market for the past 60 years and is used to transmit power over long distances with minimal losses, using overhead lines, underground and submarine cable systems.
Come as you are and be ready to learn. Bring your passion, your energy, and join a team that appreciates a simple truth: Diversity + Collaboration = Innovation.
How you´ll make an impact
You will be leading a Bid & Proposal team of technical, commercial, legal, tax and insurance experts from early pursuit stage to contract signing and execution handover.
Interpret customer requirements and translate them into a competitive end-to-end solution based on Hitachi Energy’s portfolio.
You will shape and drive the overall tender strategy, aligning technical solutions, commercial positioning, pricing, risk and customer priorities.
Enjoy working on complex tenders from both technical and commercial perspectives and thrive in a high-performing international environment.
You will lead customer interactions, clarifications and commercial negotiations, building strong relationships throughout the tender process.
Demonstrate Hitachi Energy’s core values of safety and integrity by taking responsibility for your actions and supporting your colleagues and the business.

Your background
Experience in large-scale system sales and tendering, or in managing large projects.
Bachelor’s or Masters degree in Business, Technical, or a related field.
Technical and commercial experience with HVDC, or similar technologies, is an advantage.
Strong leadership skills and a structured approach are important for guiding the tendering team through complex challenges.
You are a strong communicator who works effectively with internal and external stakeholders at all levels. You are fluent in written and spoken English.

What does it take to turn advanced semiconductor technology into products ready for customers and production? At Xenergic, it takes strong engineering, close collaboration and the ability to bring different technical disciplines together. We are now looking for an Engineering Manager to lead that work and develop our engineering organisation as we grow.
YOU WILL
Xenergic is a Lund-based semiconductor company developing high-speed, On-chip memory IP for advanced chip technologies. Our engineering teams work across several technical disciplines, developing technology that spans from transistor-level design to customer integration and mass production.
As Engineering Manager, you will lead Xenergic’s engineering organisation and take overall responsibility for product development and delivery. Working closely with the CEO, CTO and Business Development & Sales Manager, you will bring together technical direction, people and execution, ensuring that teams have the right priorities, resources and conditions to deliver.
This is a role for someone who wants to lead without losing touch with the technology. You will work across analog and digital design, software and verification, bringing different engineering disciplines together and creating the structure needed to turn advanced technology into reliable products and customer solutions.
Your main responsibilities will be to:

Lead and develop the engineering organisation across analog, digital, software and verification.

Take overall responsibility for product development and delivery, including resources, priorities, timelines and budgets.

Develop engineering processes, design methodologies and ways of working that support quality and efficient development.

Develop the team and its capabilities while creating clarity, collaboration and accountability across the organisation.

Ensure effective communication and documentation throughout product development and with relevant internal and external stakeholders.

The role reports to the CEO and is part of the management team. It is a full-time position based in Lund.
YOU ARE 
Your career has given you a strong technical foundation and experience in complex product development within semiconductors, electronics or another relevant technology environment. Over time, you have taken on broader responsibility and moved towards leading people, teams and technical delivery.
A technical university degree in electronics or a related field provides a strong foundation for the role. Equivalent technical experience may also be considered. Experience in the semiconductor industry is particularly valuable, especially within areas such as memory, chip design, verification, chip validation or silicon bring-up.
You have experience leading engineers and understand how to create the right conditions for highly skilled specialists to do their best work. You are comfortable setting priorities, making decisions and taking responsibility for delivery when several teams and technical disciplines need to work together.
As a leader, you are pragmatic and solution-oriented. You stay close enough to the technology to understand the challenges, ask the right questions and support your teams, without needing to be the expert in every technical detail. You bring structure when needed, while giving experienced engineers the trust and space to solve complex problems. Fluency in English is required.
At Xenergic, you will join a highly specialised engineering environment where technology and product development are closely connected. Short decision paths allow you to influence how the engineering organisation develops and how we take our technology from development to customer integration and production.
WANT TO KNOW MORE? 
In this recruitment, Xenergic is collaborating with Nexer Recruit. Applications are reviewed continuously, so please submit your application as soon as possible. For questions about the role or the recruitment process, please contact recruitment consultant Johanna Värmfors at johanna.varmfors@nexergroup.com or +46 730 821 230, or Artan Bitiqi at artan.bitiqi@nexergroup.com or +46 723 61 28 44.
We look forward to hearing from you.
ABOUT XENERGIC 
Xenergic is a Swedish semiconductor technology company based in Lund, developing high-speed, On-chip memory IP for advanced semiconductor applications.
Its technology addresses important challenges in modern chip design, where performance, power consumption and silicon area are becoming increasingly important. Xenergic’s solutions are relevant for applications ranging from IoT and mobile devices to networking, high-performance computing and AI.  Xenergic combines deep semiconductor expertise with a specialised engineering organisation and an international market. As we continue to develop our technology and products, joining Xenergic means becoming part of a small technology company where your work and ideas can have a real impact.

Job Scope 
Why does the role exist? High level purpose of function. 
The Senior Manufacturing Engineer plays a key role in process equipment commissioning, production ramp-up, and full-scale manufacturing within a battery cell production facility. They ensure smooth start-up of production lines, optimize manufacturing processes, and lead continuous improvement initiatives to maximize process yield, equipment availability, and overall production performance. This role combines hands-on equipment commissioning experience, cross-functional collaboration, and technical expertise to deliver safe, efficient, and high-quality battery cell production. A Senior Manufacturing Engineer is responsible for all aspects of their process machine including technical functionality, how personnel interact with it, what maintenance activities are recommended and what crucial spares are required. 
Key Responsibilities 
Overall areas of responsibilities and activities 
Key responsibilities include (but are not limited to) 
Participate in HAZOP (Hazard & Operability Study) sessions and ensure compliance with process safety, operational safety, and environmental standards.  
Promote a culture of safety, quality, and operational excellence throughout production and commissioning activities.  
Lead process equipment commissioning, including cold and hot commissioning on-site during start-up or restart projects. (Project timeline dependent)  
Facilitate smooth transitions from commissioning to production ramp-up and full-scale manufacturing. (Project timeline dependent)  
Translate lessons learned into design and process improvements for future expansions.  
Monitor, analyze and improve production KPIs, including yield, availability, and performance. Identifying top losses, production bottlenecks, and performance gaps to drive corrective actions and continuous improvement initiatives.  
Lead root cause analysis (RCA) for equipment-related losses, minor stops, and process deviations.  
Define, release, and maintain manufacturing process standards and operator training programs.  
Train and mentor new engineers, operators and other support functions.  
Prepare, review, and approve documentation including (but not limited to WI, PFMEAs, commissioning checklists, project timelines, A3s).   
Provide technical feedback and guidance to suppliers to ensure equipment quality, compliance with specifications, and CE standards.  
Develop and issue DOEs (Design of Experiments) and schedule process and equipment trials onsite and at supplier sites (if required).  
Deliver a line capable of obtaining PPAP approval, following a structured quality gate model.   
Guide and mentor colleagues to industrial best practices, focusing on growth and development.  
Complete supplementary tasks as seen fit by management to effectively utilize time and resource for the benefit of the business.  
This role requires regular presence on the production floor. 

 Requirements 
Educational background and previous experience required for the role 
Qualifications and Experience 
Master's degree in mechanical, electrical, or chemical engineering.  
Minimum of 7 years of relevant work experience in production, equipment, or engineering-related roles.  
Proven track record of leading manufacturing process improvements and production optimization in a factory environment following recognised project management techniques.   
Experience in building and scaling production in a fast-growing environment, ideally within the battery, food, pharma, paper & pulp, semiconductor, electrochemical, or similar industries.  
Hands-on experience and interest in equipment commissioning, troubleshooting, and optimisation.  
Proficient in detailed root cause analysis, structured problem-solving methodologies and continuous improvement.  
Familiarity with quality assurance troubleshooting tools.  
Experience working to industry standards obtaining certification including ISO, IATF &VDA.  
Experience with statistical process control and process capability analysis. 
Experience working with preventive maintenance strategies and Total Productive Maintenance (TPM) concepts within a production environment. 
Experience in spare part prioritisation and stock optimisation, balancing equipment availability with cost efficiency. 

 Specific skills & Knowledge  
Strong knowledge of mechanical, electrical, hydraulic, and pneumatic systems.  
Knowledge of OEE (Overall Equipment Effectiveness) metrics and their application in production environments.  
Knowledge of lean manufacturing principles and six sigma methodologies.  
Highly autonomous with a proactive mindset and work ethic.   
Strong technical curiosity, analytical mindset, and business-oriented problem-solving skills.  
Troubleshooting skills with diagnostic equipment.  
Ability to document technical problems concisely.  
Proficient in the use of a Computerised Maintenance Management System (CMMS) for work order management, equipment data, and maintenance reporting. Experience with Microsoft Dynamics 365 is advantageous. 
Experience in coaching, upskilling, and mentoring engineers or technicians, with a demonstrable commitment to developing the technical capability of others within a production environment. 
Excellent English skills, both written and oral, are essential. Basic Swedish and other language skills are a plus. You should have good communication skills and be able to work in close collaboration with colleagues from many different teams.  
Ability to work within varying environments including clean-rooms and dry-rooms, while wearing appropriate PPE.  
Comfortable operating in high-profile, international, and high-pressure environments.  
A genuine technical interest and passion about working within production is highly valued.

Vill du vara med och forma hur nordiska företag använder data och AI för att skapa affärsvärde?
På Columbus Data & AI hjälper vi företag att gå från data till beslut, innovation och konkurrenskraft. Nu förstärker vi vårt team med en senior profil som vill driva området Data Strategy & AI och hjälpa våra kunder att ta nästa steg i sin datadrivna transformation.
Om rollen
Som Principal Consultant inom Data & AI Strategy kommer du att vara en nyckelperson i vårt erbjudande och vår fortsatta tillväxt. Du arbetar nära kundernas ledningsgrupper och verksamhetsansvariga för att definiera strategier, identifiera möjligheter och säkerställa att investeringar inom data och AI leder till konkreta affärsresultat.
Du kombinerar strategiskt tänkande med affärsutveckling och är bekväm med att leda dialoger från vision och roadmap till genomförande.
I rollen kommer du bland annat att:

Utveckla och driva Columbus erbjudande inom Data Strategy & AI.

Stötta kunder i att skapa data- och AI-strategier som är starkt förankrade i verksamhetens mål.

Facilitera workshops och leda dialoger med ledningsgrupper och beslutsfattare.

Identifiera affärsmöjligheter och bidra till försäljning och tillväxt inom området.

Bygga långsiktiga kundrelationer och agera strategisk rådgivare.

Samarbeta med våra specialistteam inom data engineering, analytics, AI och modern dataplattform.

Kravprofil
Vi tror att du har en bakgrund som managementkonsult, strategikonsult eller senior rådgivare inom data, analytics eller digital transformation. Du har erfarenhet av att arbeta nära ledningsgrupper och kan översätta tekniska möjligheter till affärsvärde.
Vi söker dig som:

Har flerårig erfarenhet av data- och analysområdet och möjligheter inom AI och generativ AI.

Har arbetat med datastrategier, operating models, governance eller datadriven transformation.

Är trygg i dialog med beslutsfattare på C-level.

Har ett starkt kommersiellt driv och trivs med att utveckla affärer.

Kan skapa förtroende på både strategisk och operativ nivå.

Please note - this position is located in Sweden. It requires a valid VISA and fluency in Swedish and English.  
Ansökan och nästa steg
Hos oss ansöker du enkelt med din LinkedIn-profil eller ditt CV, utan att behöva fylla i långa frågeformulär. Du behöver inte skicka in något personligt brev. 
I vår rekryteringsprocess använder vi logik- och personlighetstester. Vi tar alltid referenser och genomför en bakgrundskontroll innan anställning eller erbjudande ges. Intervjuer sker löpande. Vid frågor är du välkommen att kontakta ansvarig rekryterare Daniel Sparrow. 
Efter avslutad rekryteringsprocess skickar vi en fråga om din upplevelse som kandidat. Det tar bara någon sekund att besvara frågan och hjälper oss att förbättra vår rekryteringsprocess.
Om Data & AI
Vilka är vi? Vi är ett team med BI-konsulter som levererar data- och AI-projekt inom Business Intelligence, AI och Machine Learning. Vi samarbetar nära med konsulter från andra affärsområden – Dynamics, M3 och Digital Commerce.
Varför? Vi vill hjälpa våra kunder att nå sina affärsmål och göra deras vardag mer effektiv! Målet är att säkerställa deras långsiktiga framgång och guida kunderna genom att vara deras Trusted Advisor. Vi samarbetar med kunderna för att optimera deras lösningar. 💫
Jobba på Columbus
Människorna kommer alltid först på Columbus. Vi är ett globalt konsultbolag med lokal närvaro, som hjälper företag med deras digitala förändring och att blomstra genom teknik, data och mänsklig insikt. Vi är också en arbetsplats där du som medarbetare får utveckla din karriär och få stöd genom tydliga och strukturerade karriärvägar.  
Vår kultur bygger på tillit, samarbete, nyfikenhet och ett gemensamt engagemang för att leverera värde till våra kunder. Oavsett om du är erfaren eller precis i början av din karriär, kommer du att hitta friheten att utforska idéer, utmana det invanda och forma din egen väg hos oss.  
Med över 1 500 kollegor i fler än 10 länder kombinerar vi globala perspektiv med lokal förståelse. Det som förenar oss är vår tro på att skapa en meningsfull påverkan – för våra medarbetare, våra kunder och resan framåt.
Let’s thrive, grow, and shape the future together.  
Vad andra säger om oss
Intresserad av Columbus bakom kulisserna? Varje vecka låter vi en kollega ta över vårt Instagram-konto. 
På Careereye kan nuvarande och tidigare medarbetare dela sina ofiltrerade omdömen om hur det är att arbeta hos oss. Klicka nedan för att läsa deras upplevelser.

SAVR is a fast-growing Swedish fintech company on a mission to reinvent investing. We empower investors with a platform that offers lower fees, greater transparency, and a radically improved experience.
We’re not just building another investment service - we’re reimagining how financial products should work for people, not just institutions. As part of our ambitious, innovative and curious team, you’ll help shape the future of investing in Sweden and beyond.
The Role 
As an Engineering Manager, you will lead and coach a cross-functional team of 6–8 engineers across frontend, backend, and AI/ML. Your focus will be on building a high-trust, accountable environment where engineers take ownership of their work and grow their skills, while also contributing to technical initiatives and ensuring reliable delivery.
You’ll balance people leadership with hands-on engagement, guiding outcomes and helping individuals grow.
Your Mission
Partner with your Product Manager to plan, scope, and deliver roadmap goals that drive customer and business impact.

Own selected technical projects, often with suppliers or partners, ensuring smooth execution from requirements to rollout.

Build a healthy, high-trust team by setting clear expectations, coaching individuals, and empowering engineers to take ownership of their growth and delivery.

Raise the team’s competence and practices by championing effective rituals, continuous learning, and strong communication.

Ensure system health and reliability through meaningful monitoring, observability, and post-mortem learning.

Promote engineering excellence by driving quality, CI/CD, and operational readiness before launch.

Act as a facilitator-leader - guiding trade-offs, unblocking decisions, and creating space for experts to excel.

Continuously improve how the team works by introducing better ways of working and helping the org adopt them.

Day-to-Day Responsibilities
Co-own backlog, scope, and planning with the Product Manager.

Run effective execution rituals (standups, planning, reviews) with transparent risk management.

Lead feedback conversations, performance reviews, and growth plans.

Partner with the Tech Lead on architecture decisions and technical strategy; contribute code when it’s high leverage.

Coordinate work with suppliers/partners and manage integrations.

Oversee access management, compliance, and KPI/observability work.

Lead by example and contribute to the codebase, such as solving bugs or deliver on features.

Additionally, You Will
Promote good engineering practices and constructive code reviews.

Foster a learning culture that values feedback and continuous skill development.

Influence platform roadmap and tech stack evolution.

Balance short-term delivery with long-term sustainability and simplicity.

You’ll Thrive in This Role If You…
Multiple years of experience from software engineering. 

Have experience leading cross-functional engineering teams in a product environment.

Can balance hands-on technical contribution with people leadership.

Are motivated by coaching, developing others, and raising the competence of your team.

Care deeply about reliable systems, observability, and safe, compliant delivery.

Demonstrate accountability, empathy, and a growth mindset.

Communicate clearly in English and/or Swedish.

Are eligible to work in Sweden (Swedish citizen or EU work permit) - we’re unable to offer visa sponsorship.

Our Cultural DNA
At SAVR, we’re:
🧠 Open-minded – we embrace new ideas, diverse perspectives, and continuous learning
🚀 Bold – we take smart risks, move fast, and aren’t afraid to fail forward
🤝 Honest – we value transparency, feedback, and doing the right thing
We’re a startup, so things can be a little messy — and that’s part of the thrill. If you thrive in building as a team and handling uncertainty, you will fit right in. 
What’s In It for You
You’ll join a product- and design-driven company where your work has real impact. We keep things lean, move fast, and genuinely care about the experience we deliver — for customers and for each other.
Here’s what we offer:
💻 Top-tier work gear
💰 Competitive salary
🏃‍♀️ Generous wellness allowance
🤒 Insurance package
🌱 Occupational pension and long-term savings support
🏢 Office-first approach to foster collaboration and quick decision-making — with flexibility when you need it (4+1)
🥗 Stocked pantry, plus regular social gatherings and wellness activities to keep energy and culture high
Our Commitment to Diversity
SAVR is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome people from all backgrounds, identities, and experiences. We believe diverse teams build better products and are committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone can thrive.
Ready to Join Us?
We’d love to hear from you. Apply now or reach out with any questions — and let’s build something meaningful together.

Lyten is leading an industrial revolution through Lyten 3D Graphene™, a breakthrough supermaterial unlocking a new generation of products — from lithium–sulfur batteries and energy storage systems to concrete admixtures, lightweight composites, and next-generation sensors that are revolutionizing industries. Together, these innovations are making a massive global improvement and driving real-world impact across energy, mobility, construction, and defense.
At Lyten, we believe the most meaningful careers begin with purpose — and with people who want to make a difference. We’re not just developing advanced supermaterials — we’re about to change the world as we know it, reshaping how energy is stored, how products are built, and how progress is made.
We’re entering an exciting growth phase, scaling production across the U.S. and Europe and expanding our team of engineers, scientists, and innovators.
Apply now to join our team and be part of something bigger than yourself — where collaboration, creativity, and purpose come together to build the technologies that will define the next century.
Job Scope 

Why does the role exist? High level purpose of function. 

The Automation Engineer (Logistics) is responsible for overall project management related to industrial material flow engineering projects for Lyten’s advanced factories and warehouses, including design and implementation of new technologies and specialized equipment. 
This role drives the development, integration, and continuous improvement of automated materialflow solutions that enable safe, efficient, and scalable operations across Lyten’s advanced factories and warehouses. 
Key Responsibilities 
Overall areas of responsibilities and activities 
Key responsibilities include (but are not limited to) 
Responsible for managing projects, timelines, track progress on projects focusing on material flow and material handling engineering.  
Responsible for design and implementation of automation systems for internal material flows for advanced factories and warehouses including:  
Design and implementation of new technologies for specialized equipment.  
Identification, evaluation and interact with key vendors. 
Responsible for coordinating engineers, project leaders and vendors to design material flow solutions. 
Ramping up the equipment to expected efficiency through manual and semi-automatic phases. 
Troubleshooting, analysing and reporting problems with equipment. Driving the necessary improvements continuously. 
Responsible for defining and contributing to following cross functional Blueprint areas, where Blueprint is referring to a lean, standardized and a flexible enough solution for a designated factory block to easily be adopted and scaled. 
Material Handling Blueprint. 
Material Flow Blueprint. 
Engineering Tools and Methods Blueprint. 
Responsible to secure and enable cross functional collaboration to Lyten Digital business unit and Factory Automation team to define technical interfaces for advanced real time monitoring, control, and optimization. 
Responsible for collaboration and interaction with Lyten final customers regarding design and implementation of material handling engineering projects. 
Contribute to profitability through efficiency improvements and cost optimization projects. 

Accountability/Authorization 
Budget responsibility: No 
Direct reports: No 
Work Environment responsibility: No 

All employees are accountable for complying with safety regulations and actively supporting a safe workplace.  
Requirements 
Education and Qualification 
Degree in Mechanical, Electronics, Mechatronics, Electrical, Automation, Engineering or similar.  
Knowledge of mechanical, electrical, or automation systems related to material flow (low to medium voltage system, variable frequency drives system and conveyor technology). 
Excellent stakeholder and supplier management. 
Experience within Industrial Automation or Automated PLC Based Systems (ASRS, AGV) and configuration of PLC, SCADA, WINCC, OPC connectivity and MES interfaces, especially using Siemens. 
Experience in writing technical documentation (Requirement specifications, Functional design, Test Cases, Test Records).  

Specific skills & Knowledge  
Safety-oriented mindset, familiar with LoTo procedures, permits-to-work, and industrial safety standards. 
Problem-solving skills with ability to work both independently and in a team. 
Strong computer literacy (CMMS and MS Office) with the ability to document work in English.  
Hands-on, practical, and structured approach to daily tasks. 
High sense of responsibility and reliability. 
Excellent English skills, both written and oral, are essential. Basic Swedish and other language skills are a plus. You should have good communication skills and be able to work in close collaboration with colleagues from many different teams.   
Continuous improvement mindset, always seeking safer and smarter ways of working. 

Health, Safety & Environmental responsibility  
Follow company policies and procedures. 
Use PPE according to safety rules. 
Report hazards and incidents.

We are now looking for a Senior Compensation & Benefits Specialist to join our HR team in Stockholm —a role that combines operational excellence with strategic impact.

Who we are
Netlight provides a full range of premium IT consulting services at the forefront of digital innovation. With more than 2,000 consultants across 15 European offices, we operate as a network organization built on trust, self-leadership, and collective expertise.
We have been recognized multiple times as a top employer for our growth, profitability, and commitment to diversity, equity, and inclusion. At Netlight, we believe in developing leaders—both within our client organizations and inside our own community.

Your future team
You will join a global HR organization of 30 colleagues across HR Operations, HR Business Partnering, Payroll, and Learning & Development. Together, we advance our global people strategy and ensure a seamless employee experience for all of Netlight.
In this role, you will collaborate closely with HR colleagues, senior stakeholders, and employees in all our locations.
Compensation & Benefits Specialist
Working in HR requires strong business acumen, analytical capability, and exceptional relationship-building skills. In this role, you will:

Act as a key stakeholder in the development and evolution of our global compensation and benefits strategy

Define, drive, and maintain compensation structures, salary frameworks, and benefits offerings aligned with business objectives

Advise HR, leaders, and employees on compensation matters, recommending best practices and providing case-specific guidance

About WAHEGURU AB
WAHEGURU AB is an established Swedish restaurant company specialising in restaurant and food service operations.
As part of our plans to develop and expand our restaurant operations, we are seeking an experienced and professionally skilled Indian Cuisine Chef who can contribute specialist culinary knowledge, maintain high food quality standards, and support the continued development of our kitchen.
We are particularly interested in candidates with extensive practical experience in authentic North Indian and Punjabi cuisine, traditional tandoor cooking, Indian curry preparation, and professional restaurant kitchen operations.
Main Responsibilities
The successful candidate will be responsible for:
Independently preparing and cooking authentic Indian dishes according to traditional recipes and restaurant quality standards.

Managing daily kitchen preparation, including curry bases, marinades, sauces, spice blends, and food preparation.

Preparing traditional North Indian and Punjabi dishes, including Butter Chicken, Chicken Tikka Masala, Lamb Karahi, Rogan Josh, Korma, Jalfrezi, and other regional specialities.

Operating and managing traditional tandoor ovens for preparing Tandoori Chicken, Chicken Tikka, Seekh Kebab, Lamb Tikka, and freshly baked Indian breads.

Preparing different varieties of naan, roti, paratha, and other traditional Indian breads.

Preparing authentic biryani, rice dishes, lentil preparations, vegetarian curries, and Indian side dishes.

Ensuring consistency in flavour, texture, presentation, cooking methods, and portion sizes.

Developing and improving menu items while maintaining authentic Indian culinary traditions.

Managing ingredient preparation, stock rotation, food storage, and minimising kitchen waste.

Maintaining kitchen hygiene, food safety, temperature controls, and allergen procedures in accordance with Swedish food safety regulations.

Coordinating kitchen operations during busy lunch and dinner services.

Supporting and training other kitchen employees in Indian cooking techniques when required.

Assisting restaurant management with menu planning, food costing, and kitchen efficiency.

Required Professional Expertise
1. Indian Curry and Gravy Preparation
Candidates must have advanced practical knowledge of traditional Indian curry preparation, including the preparation of onion-tomato gravy bases, makhani sauces, cream-based curries, slow-cooked meat dishes, and vegetarian specialities.
2. Traditional Tandoor Cooking
Professional experience operating a traditional clay tandoor oven is required, including meat marination, temperature control, tandoori grilling, kebab preparation, and baking Indian breads.
3. Indian Spices and Traditional Cooking Techniques
Candidates must demonstrate strong knowledge of Indian spices, including cumin, coriander, turmeric, cardamom, cloves, fenugreek, garam masala, and traditional spice-roasting and tempering techniques.
The chef must be capable of preparing spice blends and marinades from scratch rather than relying exclusively on ready-made commercial sauces.
4. North Indian and Punjabi Cuisine
Practical experience preparing Punjabi and North Indian restaurant dishes is particularly important. Candidates should understand traditional preparation methods and be able to maintain authentic flavours across different menu items.
5. Professional Kitchen Management
Candidates must be able to organise kitchen preparation independently, maintain food quality during high-volume service, manage ingredients efficiently, and follow professional food hygiene procedures.
Qualifications and Experience
Minimum five years of documented professional experience working as an Indian cuisine chef or specialist cook in a commercial restaurant kitchen.

Demonstrated experience in North Indian and Punjabi cuisine.

Strong practical knowledge of tandoor cooking, curry preparation, Indian breads, and biryani.

Ability to independently prepare authentic Indian dishes from raw ingredients.

Experience working in a professional restaurant environment with established food safety and quality procedures.

Ability to manage multiple food orders efficiently during busy service periods.

Good understanding of kitchen hygiene, food handling, and allergen management.

Relevant culinary education, vocational training, or equivalent professional experience.

Ability to work independently and as part of a team.

Basic English communication skills are desirable; Swedish language skills are advantageous.

Personal Qualities
We are looking for a responsible, organised, reliable, and quality-focused chef who takes pride in traditional Indian cooking.
The ideal candidate should be adaptable, capable of working under pressure, and motivated to contribute to the restaurant's long-term development.
What We Offer
Permanent, full-time employment.

Salary and employment conditions in accordance with applicable Swedish requirements and relevant industry standards.

A professional and supportive working environment.

Opportunity to contribute to menu development and restaurant growth.

Long-term professional development within an established Swedish restaurant business.

Application Procedure
Interested candidates are invited to submit an updated CV detailing their professional culinary experience, relevant qualifications, and previous employment references.
Applicants should clearly describe their practical experience in Indian curry preparation, tandoor cooking, Punjabi cuisine, and professional kitchen operations.
